currentWork.title: FINAL.36 production verified; AN15 learned numeric promotion remains paused
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.36 is merged, deployed, and live-verified. Normal project state returns to the intentionally paused AN15 evidence/promotion gate.
releaseScope: Initial HGV route origin now requires cached GPS <=5 seconds old and <=50m accuracy, otherwise a fresh maximumAge=0 fix <=50m.
Automatic reroute uses the median of three sustained accurate off-route fixes.
Extreme-distance automatic reroute replacements are rejected while the existing route remains visible.
ORS remains driving-hgv with exact vehicle restrictions, using recommended weighting rather than pure fastest.
Highway ON uses more diverse alternatives but tighter detour limits and only maximizes expressway distance among near-fast candidates.
Ordinary route line is fluorescent cyan over a dark casing; motorway/toll remains red over the same casing.
No car or straight-line fallback was introduced.

decision: Keep AN15 learned numeric promotion paused for now.
Do not add a new manual sales-outcome capture flow at this time.
Do not restore the withdrawn OCR/Analysis UI by assumption.
Do not weaken exact interval or no-lookahead safeguards merely to accumulate evidence.
Keep the deterministic production forecast baseline unchanged.
nextActions: Continue normal VENDRIVE field use on FINAL.36 and specifically watch previously problematic detour/highway cases.
If a specific route still detours, capture that exact origin/destination as new field evidence rather than broadening HGV fallbacks.
Revisit AN15 promotion only when an authorized real sales-outcome source becomes available or the user explicitly reopens the scope.
